# ARIS Stationeries

> Stationery and course equipment for Kenyan university students. Picked in Nairobi, delivered countrywide. Prices are in Kenyan shillings. Checkout is WhatsApp and M-Pesa.

The website is a JavaScript app. Product names and prices are not in the raw HTML. Use the read-only catalog API below instead of scraping pages.

## Catalog API

- Endpoint: https://ryiwclzfoctbgmkhgept.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp
- Protocol: Model Context Protocol (streamable HTTP)
- Auth: none
- Tools: search_products, get_product, list_categories, list_deals, list_testimonials

`get_product` takes the slug from a product URL, for example `foolscaps-3-scaps-ksh-10-73dbaa` from `/product/foolscaps-3-scaps-ksh-10-73dbaa`.

## Pages

- Home: https://www.arisstationaries.co.ke/
- Shop: https://www.arisstationaries.co.ke/shop
- Deals: https://www.arisstationaries.co.ke/deals
- Reviews: https://www.arisstationaries.co.ke/testimonials
- School list: https://www.arisstationaries.co.ke/school-list
- Sitemap: https://www.arisstationaries.co.ke/sitemap.xml
